verdict.rationale: Skills are transparent by design — a plain directory containing a readable SKILL.md plus optional scripts/references/assets folders (docs-52, docs-16, docs-26) — so an engineering lead can inspect the files in a repo (e.g. on GitHub) or after installation. But there is no documented install-time preview/listing command, permission diff, or built-in audit tool that shows exactly what a skill will add before installation; review relies on manually browsing the plugin/marketplace source. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install content listing or manifest diff, and any built-in review/approval workflow for skill files before they're added to Claude's toolkit.
